name: Vine
author: lilalexmed@proton.me
description: Vine is a high-performance, lightweight, multi-version Minecraft proxy built entirely in Rust, offering sub-millisecond packet routing, WASM plugin support, and modern protocol compatibility.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eux

apk add --no-cache curl jq
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "$ARCH" in
    x86_64|amd64)
        VINE_ARCH="X64"
        ;;
    aarch64|arm64)
        VINE_ARCH="ARM64"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

BINARY_NAME="vine-${VINE_ARCH}-Linux-musl"

if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    URL="$DOWNLOAD_URL"
elif [ "${VERSION:-nightly}" = "latest" ] || [ "${VERSION:-nightly}" = "nightly" ]; then
    URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_PACKAGE:-Pumpkin-MC/Vine}/releases/download/nightly/${BINARY_NAME}"
else
    URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_PACKAGE:-Pumpkin-MC/Vine}/releases/download/${VERSION}/${BINARY_NAME}"
fi

echo "Downloading Vine from: $URL"
curl -fsSL "$URL" -o /mnt/server/vine

if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    echo "Custom download URL, skipping checksum verification"
else
    curl -fsSL "${URL%/*}/checksums.sha256" -o /tmp/checksums.sha256
    EXPECTED=$(grep " ${BINARY_NAME}$" /tmp/checksums.sha256 | cut -d " " -f 1)
    if [ -z "$EXPECTED" ]; then
        echo "No checksum published for ${BINARY_NAME}"
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "${EXPECTED}  /mnt/server/vine" | sha256sum -c -
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/vine

# Generate the initial configuration without starting the proxy
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/vine.toml ]; then
    ./vine --init
fi

variables.name: Rust backtrace
variables.description:
"0" -> No backtrace is generated. This is the default behavior.
"1" -> Generates a minimal backtrace showing only relevant information about where the panic occurred.
"full" -> Generates a detailed backtrace, showing all frames leading to the panic, including functions in the Rust standard library and dependencies.
